title: dead/ metrics scan is O(n) on every drain_once invocation
description: drain_once scans dead/ to count .env files on every invocation (every retry_interval or new enqueue notification). If dead/ accumulates many files (operator fails to clear it), this scan cost grows linearly and runs potentially every few seconds. A counter maintained incrementally (incremented on move-to-dead, decremented on operator cleanup via inotify or a GC pass) would avoid the repeated directory traversal. Low urgency for typical queue sizes but will hurt if dead/ grows large in a misconfigured deployment.
